Matrix representation of system of linear equations

Given a system of linear equations 

\left\{ \begin{matrix} x_{1} - 2x_{2} + x_{3} = 0 \\ 2x_{2} - 8x_{3} = 8 \\ - 4x_{1} + 5x_{2} + 9x_{3} = - 9 \end{matrix} \right.

 The coefficient matrix is 

\begin{bmatrix} 1 & - 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 2 & - 8 \\ - 4 & 5 & 9 \end{bmatrix}

The augmented matrix is 

\begin{bmatrix} 1 & - 2 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 & - 8 & 8 \\ - 4 & 5 & 9 & - 9 \end{bmatrix}

source_flow_review.review: M3.4 read-only OCR layout source-flow review
source_flow_review.head: d370ae6007394263cd2313912caf78db0345a8b3
source_flow_review.scope: Static source tracing only; no production/test/history edits, no OCR/DB/provider requests, no tests run.

flow.finding: _layout records line text offsets and pixel bounding boxes against the stripped PyMuPDF OCR text; OCRResult returns that text and layout together. Geometry failure is represented explicitly as GEOMETRY_UNAVAILABLE with an empty lines list.

For Tesseract, process_plan assigns ocr.text and ocr.layout, then sanitize_ocr transforms only the text; layout remains unchanged. Sanitization can strip a code fence, convert HTML, normalize HTML tables, or collapse repeated newlines. The resulting OCR text is stored as chunk content and image_info.

ImageTaskQueue.result persists sanitized ocr_result together with the original ocr_layout in task outcomes. On retry, completed OCR restores both independently; any text/layout mismatch therefore persists across retries.
Generated image_ocr/image_caption chunks carry JSON image_info including ocr_layout. create_chunks inserts the image_info JSON into chunks.image_info without projecting its fields.

The parent aggregation decoder constructs only url, original_url, start_pos, end_pos, caption and ocr_text, so ocr_layout is dropped when image info is collected for parent-context retrieval. Rendering reads caption and ocr_text only; layout is not rendered or used by retrieval/context.py.

read_source_chunk reads stored image_info but its public projection returns page_number, source_type, caption and ocr_text plus reduced status; it omits ocr_layout. Thus layout is persisted internally but not exposed by this source readback API.

assessment.layout_persistence: Yes, initially retained in task outcomes and chunks.image_info.
assessment.layout_readback_or_rendering: Not in the current parent aggregation/context renderer or public source readback projection.
assessment.contract_risk: Conditional source-contract risk: sanitization may change OCR text while keeping character offsets and line text from the pre-sanitized OCR string. No sample-specific defect is asserted; whether offsets are consumed elsewhere is outside this traced path.
